nodes.description: Private uint256 guess target derived from keccak256(now) % 10 + 1, regenerated after every startGame call.
Public uint256 tracking the contract balance available as prize; updated in startGame to this.balance.
Public uint256 minimum bet amount (0.1 ether) checked in startGame and writable by onlyOwner changeMinBet.
Address deployed as msg.sender; used by the onlyOwner modifier and as recipient of withdaw transfers.
Public GameHistory[] array storing player/number pairs pushed in startGame.
External onlyOwner function that sets minBet to _newMinBet.
Public payable function that validates bet, logs GameHistory, pays out contract balance when the guess matches randomNumber, then regenerates randomNumber and prizeFund.
Public onlyOwner function that transfers _am from the contract to owner.
Payable fallback function that accepts ether without any logic (reentrancy entry point).
Attacker-controlled caller address; used as owner, as log player and as payout recipient.
now / block.timestamp used as the only entropy source for randomNumber.
External payout of the entire contract balance to msg.sender before state is fully updated, enabling reentrancy.
External transfer of _am to owner in withdaw, executed without a reentrancy guard.
Weak randomness generation from miner-controllable block.timestamp used to seed randomNumber.
User-supplied new minimum bet value passed to changeMinBet.
Player-supplied guess passed to startGame and stored in GameHistory.
Owner-supplied amount passed to withdaw and forwarded to owner.transfer.
Local GameHistory struct populated with msg.sender and _number and pushed into log.

edges.reason: Contract owner state variable is initialized directly from the untrusted msg.sender at deployment.
Untrusted msg.sender is the recipient of the full contract balance transfer in startGame.
msg.sender is written into gameHistory.player before being pushed into log.
onlyOwner modifier on changeMinBet compares msg.sender against owner to gate execution.
onlyOwner modifier on withdaw compares msg.sender against owner to gate the withdrawal.
block.timestamp (now) is the sole input to the keccak256 randomness expression.
randomNumber is assigned from the timestamp-derived keccak256 modulus, making the outcome miner-influenced.
Timestamp dependency: randomNumber's value depends on block.timestamp at assignment.
startGame recomputes randomNumber from now on every call, making the guess target predictable within a block.
startGame reads randomNumber to compare against the player's guess.
When the guess matches, startGame executes the external transfer to msg.sender before finishing state updates.
startGame writes prizeFund from this.balance after the payout logic.
Player-supplied _number is stored into gameHistory.number.
_number is compared against randomNumber to decide the payout branch.
Populated gameHistory struct is pushed into the log state array.
_newMinBet is assigned to the minBet state variable.
changeMinBet mutates minBet and is protected only by the msg.sender == owner check.
Owner-supplied _am is the value forwarded in the external transfer.
owner state variable is the recipient of the external transfer in withdaw.
withdaw performs an external transfer to owner without a reentrancy guard.
Transfer to msg.sender can invoke the payable fallback of the caller and re-enter the contract before state finalization.
Payable fallback accepts ether and increases the contract balance that backs prizeFund.

normalization_plan.reason: _newMinBet is only a transient input of changeMinBet and should be folded into that function node.
_number is a transient input of startGame and should be folded into that function node.
_am is a transient input of withdaw and should be folded into that function node.
gameHistory is a short-lived local struct built and consumed entirely inside startGame, so it merges into that function.
